baseline_demo_dataset.note: Demo used 300 inactive sample; ~2863 eligible inactive on supported exchanges per alpaca_asset_master_summary (NASDAQ 1317, NYSE 845, ARCA 469, AMEX 97, BATS 135). Estimated recoverable ~2430 at 85% probe rate.

prior_v3_control_results.note: -19.76pp demo reconstruction effect (stale-price T0 semantics, lower-bound bias)

frozen_discovery_filter.exchange_normalization: Use provider exchange field verbatim upper-cased; NASDAQ/NYSE/ARCA/AMEX/BATS exact match only. Any other exchange (including OTC, OTC_* etc.) excluded from canonical dataset.

otc_policy.reason: Production historical scanner would not have admitted OTC names: scanner requires minimum_price 5, minimum_median_dollar_volume 20_000_000, spread_quality_ceiling_bps 50, atr bounds, etc. OTC tickers dominated by warrants/preferreds/illiquid ADRs (OTC 16329 of 19192 inactive). Including them would inject unrealistic micro-cap history not tradeable by V3. Document count excluded.

symbol_format_eligibility.reject_warrants_units_if_identifiable: Do not pre-filter warrants/units by name; include them but flag via security-type heuristics in discovery report; they will be counted separately
symbol_format_eligibility.invalid_symbol_handling: INVALID_SYMBOL — persist reason code, do not treat as no_history

frozen_discovery_filter.fallback_feed: NONE — do not silently fallback to IEX; if SIP entitlement fails, record ENTITLEMENT_ERROR
frozen_discovery_filter.adjustment_raw: splits only — dividends remain separate corporate actions; adjustment=splits as in prior v2

date_range.note: Matches demo v2 range; request 2016-01-01 but bars start 2016-01-04

frozen_discovery_filter.determinism: Discovery pipeline deterministic: fetches all inactive assets matching filter, sorts by symbol+asset_id, no manual cherry-pick, no performance-informed selection

retry_policy.pagination: limit=10000 per request; daily bars 2016-2026 ~2650 bars fits single page but paginate via next_page_token until exhausted

invalid_symbol_handling.empty_vs_failure: EMPTY = provider returned success with 0 bars; INVALID_SYMBOL = provider returned 400/invalid symbol error; PROVIDER_ERROR = 500/network; ENTITLEMENT_ERROR = 403/401; never conflate failure with no_history
invalid_symbol_handling.checkpointing: Persist progress checkpoints every 50 symbols to allow resume without manual intervention; final dataset reproducible from frozen logic, not checkpoint state

ticker_rename_handling.canonical_key: provider_asset_id (Alpaca asset UUID) is primary entity identity, not ticker symbol
ticker_rename_handling.known_example: FB -> META on 2022-06-09: provider_asset_id fc6a5dcd... for META, ab5bccc3... for FB ETF reused ticker — must NOT merge
tests_required: same ticker + different provider_asset_id != same entity
historical alias + same stable asset_id == same entity
ticker_rename_handling.asof_behavior: Use provider asof mapping where available; overlapping date histories with same asset_id treated as rename continuation

stable_entity_id_semantics.entity_id: provider_asset_id UUID where available; fallback entity_{symbol} for current survivors without asset master collision, but full reconstruction must use real UUIDs for all inactive
stable_entity_id_semantics.rename_chain_format: JSON array of {symbol, valid_from, valid_to} sorted chronologically; example: [{"symbol": "FB", "valid_from": "2016-01-04T05:00:00+00:00", "valid_to": "2022-06-08T04:00:00+00:00"}, {"symbol": "META", "valid_from": "2022-06-09T04:00:00+00:00", "valid_to": null}]
stable_entity_id_semantics.duplicate_entity_rule: Same provider_asset_id mapping to simultaneous unrelated entities is hard failure

terminal_event_policy_research_definitio.status: RESEARCH-LOCAL ONLY — do not modify production PortfolioBacktestEngine yet
terminal_event_policy_research_definitio.engine_issue_audited: self._last_price may persist stale close indefinitely if held equity stops producing bars and liquidate_at_end=false
terminal_event_policy_research_definitio.information_availability_audit: Check whether Alpaca exposes authoritative delisting date/merger successor/cash consideration/terminal settlement/last tradable session; if absent state explicitly unavailable

sensitivity_policies_predeclared.T0_CURRENT_STALE_REFERENCE: existing engine semantics — stale last_price persists indefinitely (optimistic, diagnostic)
sensitivity_policies_predeclared.T1_LAST_TRADABLE_EXIT: force close at last observed tradable close with normal sell costs (still optimistic for many delistings)
sensitivity_policies_predeclared.T2_TERMINAL_HAIRCUT_50: for unresolved non-successor termination: terminal recoverable value = 50% of last close + normal liquidation cost (sensitivity, not truth)
sensitivity_policies_predeclared.T3_TERMINAL_ZERO: for unresolved non-successor termination: terminal recoverable value = 0 (severe-loss upper bound)
sensitivity_policies_predeclared.note: DO NOT optimize 50% after results; DO NOT test other haircuts; no 25/75/90 grid

terminal_event_policy_research_definitio.exclusions: Do NOT apply haircut to VERIFIED_RENAME, successor continuation, normal data gap, temporary halt, provider outage
terminal_event_policy_research_definitio.timing_rule: No look-ahead: terminal action occurs AFTER final observed tradable session; strategy cannot exit one week/bar before simply because reconstruction knows future termination. Terminal accounting is dataset/backtest lifecycle event after last bar.

frozen_v3_parameters.costs: same real costs (slippage 2bps, spread 2bps, effective-dated TAF/CAT/SEC, commission 0)
frozen_v3_parameters.note: DO NOT optimize any of these; no V4
